identity.name_status: PROVISIONAL (documented working choice for engineering integration)
identity.role: Recurring Documentary Host & Lead Technical Investigator

physical_appearance.hair: Voluminous, curly dark black hair with distinct locks and subtle warm dimensional rim lighting
physical_appearance.eyes: Large, expressive dark brown eyes with clear white catchlights and curious, focused gaze
physical_appearance.glasses: Prominent, thick dark-framed rectangular glasses with rounded corners and metallic corner hinges
physical_appearance.facial_hair: Neatly groomed, full dark brown/black beard and moustache cleanly defining the jawline and chin
physical_appearance.complexion: Warm golden-brown / olive skin tone with soft directional cel-shading
physical_appearance.build: Athletic/compact tech professional framing, upright posture with slight natural lean

signature_accessories.description: Compact reporter-style notebook with silver wire spiral binding and cream/tan pages for recording architecture metrics
Classic wooden casing with sharpened graphite lead tip
signature_accessories.held_in: Right hand, poised ready to note findings or gesture toward hardware

editorial_role_and_personality.tone: Inquisitive, scientifically rigorous, enthusiastic, calm authority, articulate
editorial_role_and_personality.relationship_to_subject: The character guides and investigates; the technical breakthrough (silicon, paper, kernel, benchmark) remains the hero.
editorial_role_and_personality.voice_narrator_link: Kokoro-82M neural TTS (voice: am_liam, General American). The character is the visual persona embodiment of this established voice.

allowed_expressions.description: Direct eye contact with viewer, slight head tilt (+/- 1.5 deg), confident subtle smile, introducing a mystery or breakthrough.
allowed_expressions.primary_use: Documentary opening hook and scene transitions

allowed_expressions.description: Gaze directed toward silicon die or hardware component, thoughtful brow line, analytical engagement.
allowed_expressions.primary_use: Examining physical processors, motherboards, or microarchitectures

allowed_expressions.description: Bright catchlight in eyes, slight affirmative nod, open expression celebrating an elegant technical mechanism.
allowed_expressions.primary_use: Explaining algorithmic breakthroughs and performance payoffs

allowed_expressions.description: Slightly raised single eyebrow, inspecting engineering tradeoffs or hardware bottlenecks.
allowed_expressions.primary_use: Explaining the memory wall, thermal dissipation, or power limits

allowed_poses.description: Chest facing 3/4 right, head turned directly to camera, holding notebook steady, engaging viewer directly.
Body and gaze oriented toward technical object (processor or robot), pencil angled toward feature.
allowed_poses.recommended_position: lower_left with hero object on right

allowed_poses.description: Positioned in dedicated host anchor zone beside scientific schematic, nodding as data flows.

prohibited_alterations: Photorealistic face replacements, deepfakes, or human actor live-action swaps.
Altering glasses shape, removing glasses, or making glasses transparent/invisible.
Removing beard or changing facial hair styling.
Changing hair texture from curly black locks to straight, blond, or alternate hairstyles.
Replacing technical jacket with casual hoodies, business suits, or meme costumes.
Exaggerated cartoon reactions, jaw drops, or anime facial distortions.
Placing host directly over subtitle safe-zones (y=1640..1820) or covering active technical data.
